name: Kachiku Oji-san ~Oji-san o Kau Koto ni Shita~
original_name: 家畜おじさん ～おじさんを飼うことにした～
source:
By the telephone pole a guy had been abandoned.
He was hurt so I took pity on him.
I thought, I should take him home with me.
But in order not to anger Uncle, I had to keep him in secret.

[Translated from the official site]
